MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_ANGER_ORB.title: Anger
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_ANGER_ORB.description: At the start of each turn, gain 2 [color=#33ccff]Shirley's Magic[/color]. Automatically dissipates after 1 turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_ANGER_ORB.title: Anger
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_ANGER_ORB.descr: Deal double damage this turn. Every 20 damage dealt, deal 1 damage to random ally including self. Removed at turn start.
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_DISGUST_ORB.des: Reflect equal damage when hit by enemy attack. Removed when HP is hit. Auto-removed at turn start.
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_SADNESS_ORB.des: Gain 1 block per card played. Heal 1 HP to random ally. Removed at turn start.
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_FEAR_ORB.title: Fear
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_FEAR_ORB.descri: Cannot play attack cards. At turn end, gain half current block and give equal block to random ally. Removed at turn start.
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_JOY_ORB.title: Joy
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_JOY_ORB.descrip: Gain 1 temporary strength down per attack played. Gain 1 energy per attack/skill/power played. Removed at turn start.
MANOSABA_LIN_ORB_EMOTION_SURPRISE_ORB.de: At turn end, record hand size. Next turn start, draw equal cards. Then removed.
